info.name: Finapse API v1
info.description:
REST API for **Finapse**, a personal-finance app (Plaid bank sync, transactions, budgets).

## Base URL
All requests use the `{{baseURL}}` variable — set it in a Postman environment to your API root including the version prefix, e.g. `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`.

## Auth
Cookie-based. Run **Auth → Login** once; it sets an HTTP-only JWT cookie that Postman reuses for every protected request. Some Plaid routes also require a verified email.

## Path variables
Requests with `:id` / `:itemId` have a placeholder under the request's **Path Variables** tab — set a real id there (grab one from **Get Items** or **Get Transaction List**).

## Folders
- **Auth** — register, login, session, profile, password/email flows
- **Plaid** — connect banks, sync, backfill, webhooks
- **Budget** — monthly budgets (one per category per month)
- **Transaction** — list, summary, categories, edit
- **Health** — uptime probe

item.name: Auth
item.description: User registration, login, session, profile, and password/email flows. Auth is cookie-based: **Login** sets an HTTP-only JWT cookie that every protected request reuses automatically. Register/login/forgot/reset are rate-limited.

request.description:
Create a new account and send a verification email. `password` min 8 chars.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Authenticate and set the HTTP-only JWT session cookie. Run this first — every protected request relies on the cookie it sets.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Return the currently authenticated user's profile.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Update the user's display name (`fullName`, 1–100 chars).

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Change the password for the logged-in user. `newPassword` min 8 chars.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Clear the session cookie.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Permanently delete the authenticated user's account and associated data.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Confirm an email address using the token from the verification email. In dev the token is printed to the API server console (no real mailer — FIN-110).

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Re-send the verification email to the logged-in user. Rate-limited.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Start a password reset; emails a reset token (printed to the server console in dev). Rate-limited.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Complete a password reset using the emailed token.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

Begin the Google OAuth flow (Passport). Open in a browser, not Postman.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

OAuth redirect target — Google calls this. Sets the session cookie and redirects to the frontend. Not called manually.

**Auth:** public — no session required.

item.name: Plaid
item.description: Bank connections via Plaid. Flow: **Create Link Token** → user completes Plaid Link on the frontend → **Exchange Token** stores an encrypted access token and does the initial sync → transactions stay fresh via the **Webhook** receiver (or manual **Sync**/**Backfill**). Create/Exchange also require a verified email.

request.description:
Create a short-lived Plaid Link token. Omit `institution_id` for a brand-new connection; pass it to enter update mode (re-auth / add accounts). Attaches `PLAID_WEBHOOK_URL` when configured.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first). Also requires a verified email.

Exchange the Link `public_token` for a permanent access token (encrypted at rest), create the PlaidItem + accounts, and kick off the initial transaction sync in the background.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first). Also requires a verified email.

Incremental transaction sync for one item using its stored cursor (only new/changed rows). This is the manual 'Sync now'.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Force a full re-sync: ignores the cursor and re-fetches the item's entire history, re-upserting every transaction to repopulate fields added after older rows were first synced (FIN-95/98). The final cursor is saved so normal syncs resume incrementally.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Register the configured `PLAID_WEBHOOK_URL` on the user's already-connected items via Plaid's itemWebhookUpdate, so banks linked before the URL was set start receiving webhooks without a relink (FIN-106). Idempotent.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

**Called by Plaid, not by you.** No auth cookie — trust comes from verifying Plaid's signed `Plaid-Verification` JWT over the raw body. `TRANSACTIONS/SYNC_UPDATES_AVAILABLE` triggers an auto-sync; `ITEM/ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED` flips the item to NEEDS_REAUTH. Included for reference; a manual call will 401 without a valid signature.

List the user's connected banks (PlaidItems) with their accounts and status.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Remove a bank connection: revokes the token with Plaid (itemRemove) and deletes the PlaidItem and its accounts/transactions locally.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Remove a single account from a connected item (the item and its other accounts stay).

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

item.name: Budget
item.description: Monthly budgets, one per category per month (unique on user+category+periodStart). `periodStart` is the first of the month (YYYY-MM-01). Spend-vs-limit is computed from the transaction summary on the frontend.

request.description:
Create a budget. `category` is a Plaid detailed category or a custom `CUSTOM_*` value; `limitAmount` is a decimal string; `periodStart` is the first of the month. Duplicate category+period returns 409.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Copy every budget from the `from` month into the `to` month. Categories already budgeted in `to` are skipped, so it's safe to re-run. Returns `{ copied }`.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

List the user's budgets. Optional `periodStart` query filters to one month; omit for all.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Fetch a single budget by id (owner-scoped).

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Update a budget's `limitAmount` (and/or `category`/`periodStart`).

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Delete a budget by id.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

item.name: Transaction
item.description: Read and edit transactions. Summary/list default to real spending — transfers and credit-card payments are excluded from headline totals unless a category filter is applied. Category precedence: user override → subscription heuristic → Plaid detailed → Plaid primary.

request.description:
Paginated, filterable list. Optional query params: `search` (name/merchant), `category` (repeatable for multi-select), `accountId`, `startDate`/`endDate`, `limit`, `cursor`. Returns transactions plus `nextCursor`, `totalAmount`, `totalCount`.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Create a manual (non-Plaid) transaction. `amount` positive = spending, negative = income. `category` sets the user override.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Aggregated totals for a period: `byCategory`, `byDay`, `totalSpent`, `totalIncome`. Transfers/card payments are excluded unless a `category` filter is passed. Powers the Dashboard and Budgets pages.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Distinct effective categories present in the user's transactions (for filter menus).

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Fetch a single transaction by id with its account and computed `isRecurring` flag.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Edit a transaction. `category` sets the user override (null clears it). `applyToMerchant: "all"` also creates a merchant rule that recategorizes this merchant's past and future transactions; `"future"` applies to new ones only.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).

Soft-delete a transaction (hidden from lists/summaries). Manual transactions only.

**Auth:** requires a valid session cookie (run **Login** first).
